paper.title: SMT-Boosted Security Types and Correctness for Low-Level MPC
paper.abstract: Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) is an important enabling technology for data privacy in modern distributed applications. We develop a new Hoare logic and type theory to automatically enforce correctness, confidentiality, and integrity properties of protocols written in the Prelude/Overture language framework. Both definition and automation of our analyses leverages SMT verification, supporting precision and efficiency. Our approach is compositional, scalable, and generalizes to arbitrary prime fields and secret sharing schemes.

paper.title: Efficient KV Cache Migration for Geo-Distributed LLM Inference in Collaborative Edge Computing
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown exceptional capabilities but rely heavily on centralized cloud GPU clusters, leading to high bandwidth costs, latency, and privacy issues. Edge computing offers a solution by deploying LLMs closer to users on edge servers, yet single edge servers often cannot meet LLMs' heavy computational demands. Collaborative Edge Computing (CEC) addresses this challenge by integrating resources of multiple geo-distributed heterogeneous edge servers, which jointly host small model shards and associated Key-Value (KV) cache for distributed inference. However, edge servers may disconnect or easily become overloaded, making it essential to migrate stateful KV cache to other servers for ensuring continuous service. Existing cloud-based KV cache management methods, such as direct cross-GPUs transmission and recomputation from input tokens are ill-suited for bandwidth-constrained and resource-limited edge environments. In this work, we propose EdgeFlow, a novel hybrid KV cache migration scheme that integrates direct KV cache transmission with activation-based recomputation, leveraging parallel computation and communication to minimize migration time. On this basis, we formulate a multi-node KV migration optimization problem and design a 2-approximation algorithm based on improved linear programming relaxation and bipartite graph techniques. Extensive experiments on a real-world distributed LLM inference platform demonstrate that EdgeFlow reduces migration time by up to 45%, significantly enhancing the robustness and efficiency of distributed LLM inference in collaborative edge computing.

screening.short_summary_zh: （基于标题与摘要）EdgeFlow 提出一种用于地理分布式协同边缘计算上 LLM 推理的 KV cache 状态迁移方案：混合直接传输与基于激活的重算以并发利用计算与通信，从而最小化迁移时间；并将迁移问题形式化为多节点优化问题，给出基于改进线性规划松弛與二分圖技术的 2-近似算法。实验在真实分布式 LLM 推理平台上显示迁移时间最多可减少 ~45%。摘要结论仅基于标题与摘要。
screening.short_summary_en: (Title-and-abstract-based) EdgeFlow is a hybrid KV cache migration scheme for geo-distributed collaborative edge LLM inference that mixes direct KV transmission with activation-based recomputation, exploiting parallel computation and communication to minimize migration time. The migration problem is posed as a multi-node optimization and a 2-approximation algorithm (improved LP relaxation + bipartite techniques) is proposed; experiments report up to 45% migration time reduction on a real LLM inference platform. Summary based only on title+abstract.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 该工作直接触及在受限带宽/不可靠边缘环境中维持状态化分布式 LLM 服务的工程核心问题。混合传输+重算以并行化迁移并引入理论近似保证，在 MPC/安全 LLM 推理场景（需要在节点间迁移中间状态或 KV 缓存）具有高度可迁移价值。仅基于摘要判断。
screening.why_interesting_en: Directly addresses state migration for distributed LLM inference at edge: the hybrid transmit+recompute strategy and a provable 2-approximation for the migration scheduling problem are highly relevant to robust, bandwidth-constrained distributed LLM serving — including secure/MPC settings that require transferring or recreating intermediate KV state. Based only on title+abstract.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 与安全多方/私有 LLM 推理高度相关：MPC 或分片化推理中频繁需要在节点间传递 KV/中间态，EdgeFlow 的迁移策略、并行计算通信与近似算法可以直接启发协议选择、迁移策略与运行时调度设计。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Highly relevant: MPC-based or sharded secure LLM inference requires migrating KV/intermediate state between nodes; EdgeFlow's hybrid migration, parallelization of compute/comm, and provable approximation algorithm can directly inform protocol selection, network-aware runtime design, and migration scheduling in secure LLM systems. Statement based only on title+abstract.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: （基于摘要）直接可迁移的方面：混合传输与重算的迁移策略（可在带宽受限的 MPC 场景中用于权衡通信与本地重算）；并行化迁移以隐藏延迟；将迁移调度表述为带理论保证的近似优化问题，以促进运行时的自适应策略。
screening.possible_transfer_en: (Title-and-abstract-based) Direct transfers: hybrid transmission+recomputation tactics to trade bandwidth vs compute (applicable to bandwidth-constrained MPC); parallelizing migration to hide latency; formulating migration scheduling as an optimization with provable approximation to drive adaptive runtime policies.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 摘要显示与已有 KV 缓存管理、状态迁移与迁移重计算策略存在交叉；需核验与云端 KV 迁移方法、分布式推理重算方案、以及已有带理论保证的调度算法的对比与差异化点。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: The abstract suggests overlap with prior KV cache management, state migration, and recomputation approaches in distributed inference; verify comparisons to cloud-based KV migration, recompute vs transfer baselines, and existing scheduling algorithms with approximation guarantees.

paper.title: Stateful Testing for Deep Learning Compilers
paper.abstract: Modern deep learning compilers compile models lazily and cache artifacts across invocations. Retained compiler state can make a later invocation incorrect even when it is correct in isolation. An analysis of 26 publicly reported issues in PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow shows that detecting such bugs requires sequences that first establish compiler state and then expose a failure. We present Rondo, a stateful testing method that represents each test case as a model paired with an invocation sequence. Rondo mutates invocation sequences and uses a Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler guided by compilation behavior to favor rarely observed behaviors. Its three-way differential oracle compares execution without compilation, compiled execution with compiler state reset, and compiled execution with state retained. It confirms stateful bugs by replaying the same invocation with state retained and reset while preserving inputs and program state, then shortens sequences while preserving the original bug. We evaluate Rondo on four deep learning frameworks using 24 common model architectures. Rondo detects 117 bugs, including 35 stateful bugs. We submit 39 bug reports, including 18 for stateful bugs; developers confirm 35 reports, including 16 for stateful bugs, and fix 18 bugs, including 11 stateful bugs. Rondo achieves the highest behavior coverage and compiler Python source-line coverage among the compared methods, with 99.26% alarm precision. It shortens 44 of 117 invocation sequences, reducing the lengths of these 44 sequences by 83.34% on average.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于标题与摘要：本文研究深度学习编译器的‘有状态’缺陷，提出Rondo：将测试表示为模型加上调用序列，变异序列并用MCMC引导以覆盖罕见编译行为；三向差分判定（无编译、编译后重置状态、编译后保留状态）确认有状态bug，并可最小化触发序列。评估发现多项确认与修复的缺陷。
screening.short_summary_en: Based only on title and abstract: The paper studies stateful bugs in deep-learning compilers and introduces Rondo, a stateful testing method that encodes tests as (model, invocation-sequence), mutates sequences using MCMC to explore rare compiler behaviors, uses a three-way differential oracle (no compilation / compiled with reset / compiled with retained state) to detect stateful bugs, and minimizes failing sequences. They found and confirmed many bugs across frameworks.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 直接涉及 compiler/runtime retained-state 导致错误的问题，方法学（sequence-based testing、三向差分判定、MCMC导向变异、序列缩短）对任何保留状态的编译/运行时（包括MPC编译器、MP-SPDZ等）高度相关。
screening.why_interesting_en: Directly relevant to issues caused by retained compiler/runtime state. The sequence-based testing, three-way differential oracle, and MCMC-guided mutation are highly relevant to compilers and runtimes that cache artifacts (including MPC compilers like MP-SPDZ). Their minimization replay approach is practical for debugging stateful failures.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 高度相关：若你的工作涉及MPC编译器、运行时缓存或跨调用优化（如MP-SPDZ、MPC编译流水线），Rondo 的测试与最小化流程可直接借鉴用于发现或回归测试有状态错误。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Highly relevant: If you work on MPC compilers or runtimes that cache artifacts across invocations, Rondo’s methodology for finding/stateful bug minimization could be directly applicable to test suites and CI for those systems.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 可以把Rondo的三向差分oracle、基于调用序列的变异与MCMC探索策略，迁移到MPC编译器与运行时的测试；还可用于验证依赖感知调度或缓存优化在保留状态下的正确性。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Rondo’s three-way oracle, invocation-sequence mutation, and MCMC-guided sampling are transferable to testing MPC compilers/runtimes and to verifying correctness of dependency-aware scheduling and cache/coalescing optimizations under retained state.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 无直接冲突；如在安全敏感系统里运行测试时注意不要泄露私有模型/数据。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: No direct conflict; when applying tests to privacy-sensitive systems, ensure test inputs/artifacts do not expose confidential models/data.
questions_to_verify_zh: Rondo的实现是否可用于非Python或自定义编译器（如MP-SPDZ）的驱动？
其MCMC采样与变异策略对特定编译器特征需做多少调优？
是否开源并能被集成到CI/回归测试流水线？
questions_to_verify_en: Is Rondo’s implementation adaptable to non-Python or custom compilers (e.g., MP-SPDZ)?
How much tuning of the MCMC sampler and mutation operators is required per target compiler?
Is the tool open-sourced and integrable into CI/regression pipelines?

deep_analysis.research_problem_zh: 基于仅标题与摘要：深度学习编译器保留的编译器状态会导致后续单次调用在有状态的上下文下表现不正确；如何以序列化的、状态感知的测试方法发现此类缺陷并最小化触发序列？
deep_analysis.research_problem_en: Based only on title and abstract: retained compiler state in deep-learning compilers can make otherwise-correct invocations fail when executed after specific sequences; how to design stateful testing that finds such bugs and shortens the failure-triggering invocation sequences.
deep_analysis.core_method_zh: 提出Rondo：将测试用例表示为模型与调用序列，使用序列变异和由编译行为驱动的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样以偏好罕见行为；采用三向差异判定器比较无编译、已编译且重置状态、已编译且保留状态的执行，确认状态性错误并回放以缩短序列。
deep_analysis.core_method_en: Rondo represents tests as a model plus an invocation sequence, mutates sequences and uses an MCMC sampler guided by compilation behavior to favor rare behaviors; a three-way differential oracle compares execution without compilation, compiled execution with state reset, and compiled execution with state retained to detect stateful bugs; it confirms and shrinks triggering sequences.
contributions_zh: 定义并实现了以调用序列为核心的有状态测试方法Rondo（摘要中描述）
引入以编译器行为指导的MCMC采样来探索少见的状态轨迹
设计三向差异判定器以精确定位因编译器状态导致的错误，并实现序列缩短
在四个深度学习框架上发现并报告大量缺陷，展示高覆盖率与高精度（摘要提供的实验成果）
contributions_en: Defines and implements the stateful testing method Rondo
Uses MCMC sampling guided by compiler behavior to explore rare stateful behaviors
Introduces a three-way differential oracle to detect compiler-state-induced bugs and shrinks sequences
Demonstrates effectiveness across four deep-learning frameworks, finding many bugs and achieving high coverage and precision (per the abstract)
deep_analysis.why_watch_zh: 与主课题关联：编译器/运行时的状态性错误同样可能发生在MPC编译器或安全运行时（例如缓存、跨调用的优化状态），Rondo的方法学（序列化测试、三向差分、序列压缩）对MPC编译器测试与回归检测具有直接借鉴意义。
deep_analysis.why_watch_en: Relevance: stateful bugs can also affect MPC compilers and secure runtimes (e.g., caches, cross-invocation optimization state). Rondo's methodology—sequence-based testing, three-way differential oracle, and sequence shrinking—can be directly useful for testing MPC compilers and runtimes.
deep_analysis.direct_relation_zh: 直接关联：MPC编译器和MPC运行时中的状态性错误检测、编译器测试与回归检测。与调度/通信优化的直接关系较弱，但测试方法可用于发现与这些优化相关的状态错误。
deep_analysis.direct_relation_en: Directly relevant to detecting stateful bugs in MPC compilers and runtimes, and to compiler testing/regression detection. Less directly related to scheduling/communication optimization, but the testing approach can uncover stateful bugs introduced by such optimizations.
transferable_mechanisms_zh: 将测试用例视为“程序+调用序列”的表示法适用于任何有跨调用状态的系统（包括MPC运行时）
三向差异判定器（no-compile / compile+reset / compile+retain）能定位是否为编译器保留状态引起的错误
基于编译行为引导的MCMC采样和序列变异可提高对稀有状态路径的覆盖率
序列缩短（最小触发集合）对故障定位与开发者修复非常有用
transferable_mechanisms_en: Representing tests as program+invocation-sequence applies to systems with cross-invocation state (including MPC runtimes)
The three-way differential oracle (no-compile / compile+reset / compile+retain) helps localize whether an error is due to retained compiler state
Compilation-behavior-guided MCMC sampling and sequence mutation increase coverage of rare stateful paths
Sequence shrinking to find minimal triggering sequences is valuable for debugging and fixes
deep_analysis.potential_overlap_zh: 该方向与已有的编译器模糊测试、差分测试、状态化回归测试工具在目标和技术上可能有交叉；摘要未列出与现有工具的定量对比细节。
deep_analysis.potential_overlap_en: This overlaps conceptually with existing compiler fuzzers, differential testing, and stateful regression-testing tools; the abstract does not provide detailed quantitative comparisons to prior approaches.
deep_analysis.potential_conflict_zh: 无明显冲突。现实风险包括对复杂、分布式或需保密的MPC执行环境重放的可行性（重放可能受安全/隐私/多方协作限制）。
deep_analysis.potential_conflict_en: No clear conflicts. Practical issues include feasibility of replaying sequences in complex, distributed, or privacy-sensitive MPC environments, where replay may be constrained by security or multi-party coordination requirements.

序列变异操作集与接受准则有哪些？
三向差异判定器的精确判定策略与容错阈值如何设置？

工具开源性与易用性（对不同框架的适配成本）如何？
full_text_questions_en: What signals/features guide the MCMC sampler and how is “rare behavior” quantified?
What mutation operators and acceptance criteria are used for sequence mutation?
What is the exact decision logic and tolerance for the three-way differential oracle?
How is deterministic replay handled in distributed/multi-party runtimes (e.g., MPC) if attempted?
What is the sequence-shrinking algorithm and does it guarantee minimality or an approximation?
Is the tool open-source and how costly is adaptation to new frameworks?

experiment_checks_en: Verify bug confirmation process (reproducibility and availability of test cases/replay scripts)
Assess adaptation difficulty and effectiveness on target systems (e.g., MPC compilers)

对比Rondo与现有编译器测试工具在发现状态性错误方面的效果与成本
next_steps_en: Obtain Rondo implementation and try adapting it to target MPC compilers (e.g., MP-SPDZ, Prelude/Overture)
Design mutation and replay strategies tailored to MPC semantics (secret-sharing, distributed replay)
Compare Rondo against existing compiler testing tools for effectiveness and cost in discovering stateful bugs

paper.title: Local Epochs as Optimal Stopping: Theory and Evidence in Federated Learning
paper.abstract: How long should each client train before communicating? Federated learning usually answers with a fixed, hand-tuned number of local epochs, yet an extra epoch helps only while the loss it removes outweighs the client drift it adds. We cast local training as finite-horizon optimal stopping: a client trains while the next epoch's expected loss reduction exceeds its priced squared drift. We prove that this one-stage look-ahead threshold is optimal whenever stopping decisions are nested, derive closed forms for geometric and power-law returns, and show that an estimated rule loses utility only through wrong-signed decisions. Epoch-level evidence supports the model's structure (geometric diminishing returns and additive drift) and reveals a simple regularity: the stage of training, not the client, sets the budget. The resulting rule, FedStop, is never more than one point below tuned FedAvg in mean accuracy. Where its budgets vary, it raises worst-decile accuracy by 4-8 points over tuned FedAvg and an adaptive-interval baseline, and every one of these gains remains significant after a Holm correction. Against the client-side stopping rules ALT and FLASH, it has the highest CIFAR-10 worst decile on every seed and is level elsewhere. It stays stable where per-client early stopping collapses, and each stopping decision takes constant time.

screening.short_summary_zh: 作者将联邦学习中的本地训练轮次数问题建模为有限时域的最优停止问题：客户端在下一轮预期损失降低超过定价的平方漂移时停止训练。提出规则 FedStop，理论上给出单步前瞻阈值的最优性条件，提供闭式解并在 CIFAR-10 等实验中展示比调参的 FedAvg 在最差分位上更鲁棒的效果（基于摘要）。
screening.short_summary_en: The paper frames local epochs in federated learning as a finite-horizon optimal stopping problem: train until the next epoch's expected loss reduction is less than a priced squared client-drift. They derive a one-step look-ahead threshold rule (FedStop), closed forms for certain return models, and empirical results showing improved worst-decile accuracy over tuned FedAvg and other baselines (based on the abstract).
screening.why_interesting_zh: 与隐私保留机器学习紧密相关；在 MPC/secure aggregation 上可影响 client-side computation budgeting and communication frequency 的设计，尤其当WAN延迟或通信成本高时，自动化本地训练预算有助于运行时调度与延迟-通信折中。
screening.why_interesting_en: Closely related to privacy-preserving ML. The stopping rule could inform client-side computation budgeting and communication frequency in MPC/secure aggregation settings, relevant for WAN-latency-aware runtime scheduling where local work vs. communication tradeoffs matter.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 可直接借鉴于 MPC/secure-inference runtimes：FedStop 的预算决策逻辑或许能用于决定何时在客户端/参与方执行本地预处理、何时触发通信或切换协议（如更少轮次但更重本地计算）。但需验证模型在异构/有恶意延迟场景下的稳健性。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Potentially usable in MPC/secure-inference runtimes: FedStop's budgeting could guide when to perform local precomputation vs. trigger communication or protocol switches (fewer rounds with heavier local compute). Need to verify robustness under client heterogeneity and adversarial/straggler behaviors.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 决策阈值形式（基于预期收益与漂移代价）可以被迁移为 MPC 任务的本地批次大小/本地迭代数自适应规则；可与延迟模型结合用于 WAN-aware 调度器或协议选择器。
screening.possible_transfer_en: The threshold decision (expected gain vs. priced drift) could be adapted to MPC tasks for deciding local batch sizes/local iterations; combine with latency/cost models to drive WAN-aware schedulers or protocol selectors.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 若已有工作在 MPC 场景采用手工或学习的本地训练预算策略，FedStop 可能与之重叠；摘要未提及对非合作/恶意客户端的处理。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: Possible overlap with existing MPC works that use hand-tuned or learned local-training budgets; the abstract does not address non-cooperative or adversarial clients.
questions_to_verify_zh: FedStop 在高异构性（数据分布、算力、延迟）客户端集合上的表现如何？
论文是否提供与真实网络延迟/带宽模型耦合的评估，或仅在 IID/CIFAR-10 风格任务上测试？
实现是否需要额外通信/计量开销来估计‘漂移价格’？该估计如何高效计算？
questions_to_verify_en: How does FedStop perform under high client heterogeneity (data, compute, latency)?
Are evaluations coupled with realistic network latency/bandwidth models, or only on IID/CIFAR-10-like settings?
Does FedStop require extra communication/measurement overhead to estimate the 'priced drift', and how is that computed efficiently?

paper.title: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Learning for Joint Communication and Computation in XR Systems
paper.abstract: The convergence of communication and computation, empowered by artificial intelligence (AI) enhanced capabilities, emerges as a key enabler for realizing the promising functionalities of the sixth-generation of communication systems (6G). To this end, this paper investigates an AI-native, robust network, where multiple base stations (BSs) simultaneously serve several extended reality (XR) devices. The paper then presents an innovative distributed deep learning-based approach to simultaneously manage the transmit and computing powers, and computation allocation, amidst uncertainties in both channel and computing states information. Under such an interference network scenario, the paper proposes a robust approach for minimizing the worst-case delay across the served XR devices, subject to computation and power constraints. The paper leverages a deep neural network (DNN) that can be trained either centrally or in a federated manner to map estimated channels and computation requirements to optimized resource allocations per BS. During training, uncertainty samples, reflecting both channel and computing estimation errors, are injected after the DNN output to account for such joint uncertainties. Our results validate the enhanced robust delay performance and scalability of joint uncertainty injection as compared to uncertainty-agnostic methods and state-of-the-art benchmarks, with federated learning-based solutions achieving near-centralized performance while enhancing efficiency, privacy, and adaptability.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于标题与摘要：面向6G情境，本文研究多基站为若干XR设备提供服务的鲁棒网络资源分配问题，提出在信道/计算状态不确定下通过中心化或联邦训练的DNN映射估计信息到每基站的发射与算力分配；训练时注入代表不确定性的样本以提升最坏情况延迟性能。
screening.short_summary_en: Based only on title and abstract: The paper studies an AI-native robust network for multi-BS serving XR devices, proposing a DNN-based resource allocation (transmit power, compute allocation) trained centrally or federatedly; they inject uncertainty samples post-DNN output to handle channel and compute estimation errors and minimize worst-case delay under constraints.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 直接涉及联合通信与计算分配、联邦/网络-aware训练策略和鲁棒性——这些主题与网络感知运行时与跨节点资源协调高度相关。
screening.why_interesting_en: Touches joint communication-computation allocation, federated training, and robustness to estimation errors—topics relevant to network-aware runtimes and protocol/resource selection for distributed ML or secure inference.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 与网络感知运行时、WAN延迟优化和协议选择有较好契合；可借鉴其鲁棒训练（不确定性注入）与分布式/联邦部署经验。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Good fit for network-aware runtime concerns, WAN latency mitigation, and protocol/resource selection; their robust/federated training and uncertainty-injection techniques could be transferable.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 方法可为MPC/私有推理场景提供资源分配或调度策略的学习式控制思路，特别是在估计不确定性和联邦部署方面。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Approach could inform learned resource/scheduling controllers for MPC or privacy-preserving inference, especially handling state/measurement uncertainty and federated deployment.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 若将DNN决策嵌入安全推理场景，需注意隐私/安全约束（例如不泄露链路或负载信息），这是额外实现负担。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: Embedding DNN-based allocation into secure inference/MPC may raise privacy/leakage concerns (e.g., exposing link/load info) and require safe design.
questions_to_verify_zh: 评估中是否包含广域网（高延迟/高抖动）场景？
不确定性注入具体如何构造、是否对联邦训练收敛有副作用？
是否公开代码与训练/评估设置以便复用？
questions_to_verify_en: Do evaluations include WAN/high-latency/high-jitter scenarios?
How exactly are uncertainty samples constructed and do they affect federated training convergence?
Is code/data released to reproduce allocation policies and deployment profiling?

paper.title: Resource-aware Sub-network Allocation for Heterogeneous Decentralized Learning
paper.abstract: System heterogeneity in computation, communication, and memory can substantially limit synchronous decentralized learning, where each training round is constrained by resource-limited nodes. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly determining node-specific model capacities from deployment resources. We propose RASA-DL, a resource-aware sub-network allocation framework that treats the maximum sub-network width assigned to each node as a deployment variable. RASA-DL combines offline hardware profiling of computation and memory costs with deployment-aware profiling of learning utility under heterogeneous decentralized training. Using these profiles together with node- and link-level resource information, we formulate deployment as a bottleneck-latency minimization problem subject to per-node memory constraints and a required aggregate learning utility. Exploiting the monotone feasibility of the latency threshold, RASA-DL efficiently identifies the deployment through a binary-search-based allocation procedure. Experiments under controlled resource heterogeneity demonstrate favorable accuracy--latency tradeoffs. Under the Moderate and Severe regimes, the minimum-latency operating point improves accuracy over the largest globally feasible uniform deployment by 2.80 and 2.43 percentage points, respectively, at the same modeled round latency. The advantage is further amplified under strong Non-IID data heterogeneity.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于标题与摘要：提出RASA-DL，一个资源感知子网络分配框架，将每个节点可用的子网络宽度作为部署变量，结合离线硬件概况与部署时学习效用剖面，将部署表述为在内存约束下的瓶颈延迟最小化问题，并通过二分搜索的可行性判定高效求解。实验在受控异构性下显示对延迟—精度权衡有利。
screening.short_summary_en: Based only on title and abstract: RASA-DL is a resource-aware sub-network allocation framework that chooses per-node maximum sub-network widths using offline hardware profiling and learning-utility profiles; it formulates deployment as a bottleneck-latency minimization under memory constraints and uses binary-search over latency thresholds to find feasible allocations, improving accuracy-latency tradeoffs under heterogeneity.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 直接触及异构分布式训练中的部署变量分配、延迟瓶颈最小化与可扩展的求解逻辑，对设计异构MPC或分布式推理的调度器/部署器有借鉴意义。
screening.why_interesting_en: Addresses per-node capacity allocation under heterogeneity and formulates an efficiently solvable bottleneck-latency minimization—relevant to scheduling and deployment of heterogeneous distributed ML and potentially MPC runtimes.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 与依赖感知调度、网络/节点异构性处理紧密相关；其二分+可行性检验的求解策略可为在线/离线部署决策提供模板。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Closely related to dependency-aware scheduling and heterogeneity-aware deployment; their binary-search feasibility approach could be adapted for runtime allocation decisions in MPC systems.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 可将其离线硬件剖面与学习效用表征用于MPC部署决策（例如选择不同协议或本地资源配置），并把瓶颈延迟目标替换为回合延迟或吞吐量指标。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Offline hardware profiling and learning-utility profiling could be reused for MPC deployment choices (protocol selection, per-node resource caps), and the bottleneck-latency formulation can be mapped to round-latency or throughput objectives.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 将学习效用与安全/隐私约束联合考虑时，可能需要额外的约束建模。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: When combined with privacy/security constraints, the optimization needs extra constraints (e.g., certain nodes cannot host particular sub-networks), which changes feasibility.
questions_to_verify_zh: 學習效用剖面如何构建，是否对非IID数据场景做充分建模？
二分方法在更大规模节点/模型空间上的可扩展性如何？
是否能处理动态资源变化或在线重配置？
questions_to_verify_en: How are learning-utility profiles constructed and do they model strong non-IID scenarios sufficiently?
How does the binary-search approach scale to many nodes/models?
Can the method handle dynamic resource changes or online reconfiguration?
